findings.title: Price change and sale mix impact sentiment

report.summary: During the window, total reviews reached 2252 across 8 sale days with a positive share of 42.98 percent compared to a baseline window of 1288 reviews and a positive share of 50.31 percent. The estimated patch effect on positive share at horizon 7 was 6.53 percentage points with a p-value of 0.667. Off-topic negative review share changed by 0.08 percentage points in the window compared to baseline. Reviewers with under 2 hours of playtime accounted for 22.38 percent of window reviews compared to 3.42 percent in the baseline. A price change or sale is supported. The patch, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is rejected.
